definitions.explanation: A value expressed as a number, used in measurements, calculations, data analysis, and statistics. Refers to the quantitative representation of something rather than qualitative description.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧な{数値|すうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}して→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter the exact numerical value.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数値|すうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me my blood pressure numbers are high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数値|すうち}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are things that sales figures alone don't reveal, so it's necessary to listen to voices from the field as well.

notes:
USAGE:
A widely used word in science, medicine, business, and computing. Often appears in discussions of data, test results, and performance metrics. Can refer to any quantified measurement: blood pressure readings, temperature, test scores, statistics, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数値|すうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to enter a numerical value
- {数値|すうち}⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: numerical target
- {数値|すうち}⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧: numerical data
- {数値|すうち}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: quantification, digitization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧: number, digit (the symbol itself, e.g., 1, 2, 3)
- ⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧: value (mathematical or abstract)
